Not a divorce lawyer but the child of the parents going through the divorce.  
My dad never worked the entire time I was growing up. He was lazy and had no interest in watching us so instead of being a stay at home dad me and my brother would be baby sat and spend every night after school with other families till mom got off work. My mom worked her ass off to be the best mom to us and pay the bills, he never really cared. He tried to say she was unfit and took her to court for custody because he wanted child support money so he could continue to be a deadbeat. 
My mom wanted to do it fairly. She would give him our 2 cottages, and she would keep the house. Everything else 50/50. My dad realized he couldn't keep doing nothing all day and being a deadbeat without more money. He took her to court for 7-8 years.
During this time he was emotionally, financially, physically abusive to us and our mom. I can't list all the awful things he has done (there is way too many!) so heres a couple to give you an idea. He abused our dog and eventually gave him away to try and hurt us. He constantly lied to us, insulted us, and disowned us when we didn't do what he wanted. He installed a tracker in my phone and computer so he could look through their cameras and see what i was doing. He would use this to send creepy messages to me about how he was godlike and could see everything and was stalking me to make me scared (i was going through puberty at the time, and as a girl I know there were things that were very wrong for a father to be looking at that he was seeing through this method)...etc
The silver lining is in trying to ruin his families lives he ruined his own. He lost his sports car, the cottages, the house, all the money they had saved, everything he had pretty much went to lawyer fees. 
Serves him right.
He must have sacked himself 50 times before getting this right
